blocks.text: TARLAC CITY– The Tarlac State University (TSU) is hosting the Professional Disc Golf Association (PDGA) Asia Summit from Wednesday to Friday, opening its doors as the first permanent university-based disc golf course in the Philippines. Delegates from 14 countries are competing at the TSU Lucinda campus in Tarlac City. The 9-hole course features a beginner-to-intermediate par 3 layout and is equipped with standard DISCatcher Pro 24 targets. The golf course was installed in November 2025 in the TSU Lucinda campus’ mini forest and developed through the PDGA Marco Polo Grant Project.
